_comment: Standardized voice and pacing configuration across all seven script formats.
Every category uses the same voice profile: Alex — Upbeat, Energetic and Clear (220-240 WPM, target ~230 WPM).
Run `python tools/clip.py voices` to resolve Alex's voice_id on your ElevenLabs account (saved to config/voices.local.json).

pacing.note: Target narration speed is 220-240 WPM (~230 WPM average). Eleven v4/v3 do not accept a numeric speed parameter; brisk pacing comes from Alex's energetic voice profile, tight conversational scripts (170-198 words for ~50 s), minimal pauses, and delivery tags like [energetic], [upbeat], and [fast-paced]. On v2 fallback models (eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_flash_v2_5), `speed` is set to 1.2 (ElevenLabs API maximum).

Alex.character: upbeat, energetic, clear, conversational, expressive, confident, fast-paced storyteller

unspoken-rules.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and conversational, leaning into eerie curiosity and suspense. Brisk 220-240 WPM pace; shift naturally with [knowing], [suspicious], [serious], [dramatic], and [deadpan] or [amazed] on the chilling final twist.

slow-burn.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and gripping. Keep forward momentum at 220-240 WPM; build taut tension with [serious], [suspicious], and [fast-paced], then land the perspective flip with emotional contrast ([dramatic], [amazed], [knowing]).

twist.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and mischievously confident. Fast 220-240 WPM friend-telling-a-story rhythm; mix [energetic], [amused], [knowing], [suspicious], [dramatic], and punchy [deadpan] or [ironic] payoffs.

rule-of-three.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and playful. Brisk 220-240 WPM storytelling with comedic timing; use [upbeat], [amused], [confused], [dismissive], [knowing], and [ironic] or [laughs] as the clever third try lands.

micro-butterfly.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and incredulous storyteller (never a dry lecture). Fast 220-240 WPM domino momentum; use [energetic], [knowing], [fast-paced], [suspicious], [dramatic], and [ironic] or [deadpan] on the jaw-dropping final detail.

ticking-clock.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and high-stakes. Tight 220-240 WPM adrenaline without sacrificing intelligibility on key survival details; drive urgency with [energetic], [fast-paced], [serious], [dramatic], and [excited] or [amazed] on the escape.

reverse-chronology.delivery: Alex — upbeat, energetic, clear, and fast-on-his-feet comedic thriller energy. Crisp 220-240 WPM pace; play up the absurd opener and frantic rewind with [energetic], [confused], [amused], [fast-paced], [excited], and [knowing] or [laughs] on the payoff.
